events.description: Fired by the alert processor for queued alerts (follows, subs, raids, donations, etc.). Only overlays listed in ``queue_holders`` may emit ``alert_playing`` / ``alert_complete`` for that item (typically ``alerts`` plus a matching Queued point-reward template). Spectator overlays such as bars and counters must not handshake.
events.label: Alert (queue)

payload.label: Overlay routes allowed to hold the queue

events.description: Fired by the alert processor for non-blocking alerts that do not participate in the queue handshake. Use this for sub bars, counters, and anything that updates without holding the queue.
events.label: Alert (instant)

events.description: Fired when entries open (Start giveaway or Reopen entries). keyword is what viewers type.
events.label: Giveaway started

events.description: Fired when a chat user is added to the giveaway pool.
events.label: Giveaway entry

events.description: Fired when entries close. The pool stays until a new giveaway.
events.label: Giveaway entries closed

events.description: Fired by New giveaway: the pool and keyword are cleared.
events.label: Giveaway cleared

events.description: The whole giveaway at once: sent when an overlay loads or refreshes, and when an entrant is removed in Mycelian. Use it to rebuild lists and labels.
events.label: Giveaway state

events.description: Fired when winners are drawn. Winners is a list of names; pool_entries is every name that was in the pool.
events.label: Giveaway winner

events.description: Fired when a chat poll starts, receives a vote, or changes. Options are ordered by votes, highest first.
events.label: Poll update

events.description: Fired when a poll is stopped or its timer runs out. Winners lists every option tied for the most votes.
events.label: Poll ended

events.description: Fired when the Spotify track or playback position changes.
events.label: Now playing (Spotify)

events.description: Broadcast when alert settings change. Bind to this if your overlay needs to reset state or reload assets.

events.description: Sent when the user pauses the alert system.
events.label: Alerts paused

events.description: Sent when the user resumes the alert system.
events.label: Alerts resumed

events.description: Sent on every pause/resume toggle and at startup.
events.label: Pause status update

events.description: Fired for every Twitch chat message ingested by Mycelian. Carries the full message payload — username, message body, user color, badges, emote map, and message type.
events.label: Chat message (Twitch)

events.description: Overlay banner on the chat template. Twitch announcements, connectors, chatbot, giveaways, Source Controls, and other templates all use this payload. Style fields override Banner Options.
events.label: Chat banner

events.description: Connector-driven chat message — fired by the chat template's 'Add message' connector action (handy for bot replies, Stream Deck shoutouts, etc.).
events.label: Chat message (connector)

events.description: Sent when a moderator deletes a chat message or times out a user; chat overlays use this to fade or strikethrough the affected messages.
events.label: Chat moderation event

events.description: Configure the Helix URL and optional query/body JSON in the inspector.
